select i.*
from maya_grafana.otlp_metric."
--ttl=150
--refresh=75
--cache=false
--columns=evaluate_status,last_status,title,sensor,host,alarm_name,plugin_instance,type,type_instance,datasource,currentvalue,notification_description,site_name_from_alert,m_overlay,m_iface,alarm_description,alarm_id,time,alert_time,alert_time_since,silenced,resolve_count,alarm_count,nodata_count
--dbtype=pg

WITH labels AS (
  SELECT
    ai.rule_uid,
    ai.labels_hash,
    ai.current_state,
    ai.last_eval_time,
    ai.current_state_since,

    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'grafana_folder'            THEN e->>1 END) AS sensor,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'host'                     THEN e->>1 END) AS host,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'm_notif_plugin'           THEN e->>1 END) AS alarm_name,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'm_notif_plugin_instance'  THEN e->>1 END) AS plugin_instance,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'm_notif_type'             THEN e->>1 END) AS type,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'm_notif_type_instance'    THEN e->>1 END) AS type_instance,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'm_datasource'             THEN e->>1 END) AS datasource,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'm_currentvalue'           THEN e->>1 END) AS currentvalue,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'notification_a'           THEN e->>1 END) AS notification_description,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'site_name_a'              THEN e->>1 END) AS site_name_from_alert,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'm_overlay'                THEN e->>1 END) AS m_overlay,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'm_iface'                  THEN e->>1 END) AS m_iface,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'max_date_num'             THEN e->>1 END) AS max_date_num,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0 = 'status'                   THEN e->>1 END) AS last_status

  FROM alert_instance ai
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(ai.labels::jsonb) AS e
  WHERE lower(ai.current_state) IN ('pending','normal', 'failure', 'warning', 'error','alerting')
  GROUP BY
    ai.rule_uid, ai.labels_hash, ai.current_state, ai.last_eval_time, ai.current_state_since
),

active_silenced AS (
  -- list of labels_hash values that are currently silenced (active)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    trim(both '""' from a.value::text) AS labels_hash
  FROM maya_silence ms
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(ms.silenced_alerts::jsonb) a
  WHERE lower(ms.status::jsonb ->> 'state') = 'active'
),

last_anno AS (
  -- last annotation row per alert_id
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.alert_id)
    a.alert_id,
    lower(a.prev_state) AS prev_state,
    lower(a.new_state)  AS new_state,
    CASE
	  WHEN a.data IS NULL THEN NULL
	  WHEN a.data::jsonb -> 'values' IS NULL THEN NULL
	  ELSE (a.data::jsonb -> 'values' ->> 'A')
	END AS severity_new
  FROM annotation a
  ORDER BY a.alert_id, a.id DESC
)

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN lower(l.last_status) = 'failure' THEN 'Alerting'
    WHEN lower(l.last_status) = 'warning' THEN 'Warning'
    ELSE l.current_state
  END AS evaluate_status,

  l.last_status,
  ar.title,
  l.sensor,
  l.host,
  coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title) AS alarm_name,
  l.plugin_instance,
  l.type,
  l.type_instance,
  l.datasource,
  l.currentvalue,
  l.notification_description,
  l.site_name_from_alert,
  l.m_overlay,
  l.m_iface,

  CASE
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='operational_status' THEN 'Control Plane Down'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='maya_temperature'   THEN 'System Interval Temperature'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='metric_absence'     THEN 'Monitoring agent down'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='sdnc_node_cpu'      THEN 'SDNC Node Cpu High'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='sdnc_node_ram'      THEN 'SDNC Node Memory High'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='sdnc_node_disk'     THEN 'SDNC Node Disk High'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='maya_ifstatus'      THEN 'Interface Down'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='maya_bfd'           THEN 'Data Plane Down'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='df'                 THEN 'High Disk Usage'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='cpu'                THEN 'CPU Utilization Exceeded'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='alert_licence'      THEN 'Alert Licence'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='memory'             THEN 'RAM Utilization Exceeded'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='maya_probe' AND l.datasource='avg_delay'        THEN 'Delay'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='maya_probe' AND l.datasource='jitter'           THEN 'Jitter'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='maya_probe' AND l.datasource='loss_percentage'  THEN 'Packet Loss'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='maya_system_services' THEN 'Service Down'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='maya_dhcp_relay'       THEN 'DHCP Server Unreachable'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='maya_dhcp'             THEN 'DHCP Lease Pool Exhaustion'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='maya_bgp'              THEN 'BGP Peer Down'
    WHEN coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)='ntp_out_of_sync'              THEN 'NTP Out of Sync'
    ELSE coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title)
  END AS alarm_description,

  -- trim(both '""' from (ar.annotations::jsonb->'alarm_id')::text) AS alarm_id,
  COALESCE( (COALESCE(NULLIF(ar.annotations,''),'{}')::jsonb ->> 'alarm_id'), '' ) AS alarm_id,

  to_timestamp(l.last_eval_time) AS time,

  to_timestamp(
    coalesce(
      (l.max_date_num::double precision)/1e9,
      (l.current_state_since::double precision)
    )
  ) AS alert_time,

  round(
    extract(
      epoch from (
        now() - to_timestamp(
          coalesce(
            (l.max_date_num::double precision)/1e9,
            (l.current_state_since::double precision)
          )
        )
      )
    ) / 3600,
    0
  ) AS alert_time_since,

  CASE WHEN s.labels_hash IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS silenced,

  CASE
    WHEN la.prev_state='alerting' AND la.new_state='normal' THEN 1
    ELSE NULL
  END AS resolve_count,
  CASE
    WHEN la.severity_new='2'   THEN 'CRITICAL'
    WHEN la.severity_new='1'   THEN 'WARNING'
    ELSE  'NORMAL' 
  END AS severity_new1,
  CASE WHEN lower(l.current_state)='alerting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS alarm_count,
  CASE WHEN lower(l.current_state)='nodata'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS nodata_count

FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN alert_rule ar
  ON ar.uid = l.rule_uid

LEFT JOIN active_silenced s
  ON s.labels_hash = l.labels_hash

LEFT JOIN last_anno la
  ON la.alert_id = ar.id

WHERE s.labels_hash IS NULL
 
 " as i

select
	i.*,
	device.maya_os_version
from
	maya_tenant.otlp_metric."
    --ttl=150
    --refresh=20
    --cache=true
    --name=Data Plane Status Sites And Overlays
    --columns=host,created_at,updated_at,mac_addres,site_name,type,iface_with_split,iface,overlay_name,overlay_iface_name,ip_address,bandwidth,jn,latitude,longitude,operational_status,administrative_status,location_group,carrier,ishub_value,islanif,is_mng_iface,is_configured,template_name,template_version,device_id,model_id,maya_os_version
    --dbtype=pg
	WITH tv_json AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT site_id, template_version_id, coalesce(site_config_data, tmp_site_config_data)::jsonb AS cfg
		FROM public.site_temp_version_state
	),
	stvs_parsed AS (
		SELECT site_id, template_version_id,
			   cfg->'template'->>'name' AS template_name,
			   cfg->'version' AS template_version,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'name')::text) AS name,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'ethernet'->'address')[0]::text) AS ip_address,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'ethernet'->'bandwidth')[0]::text) AS bandwidth,
			   'ethernet' AS type,
			   e->'ethernet'->'islanif' AS islanif,
			   e->'ethernet'->'protect' AS protect
		FROM tv_json,
			 jsonb_array_elements(cfg->'interfaces'->'ethernet') e
		WHERE cfg->'interfaces'->'ethernet' IS NOT NULL AND (cfg->'interfaces'->'ethernet')::text != 'null'

		UNION ALL

		SELECT site_id, template_version_id,
			   cfg->'template'->>'name' AS template_name,
			   cfg->'version' AS template_version,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'name')::text) AS name,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'wwan'->'address')[0]::text) AS ip_address,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'wwan'->'bandwidth')[0]::text) AS bandwidth,
			   'wwan' AS type,
			   e->'wwan'->'islanif' AS islanif,
			   e->'ethernet'->'protect' AS protect
		FROM tv_json,
			 jsonb_array_elements(cfg->'interfaces'->'wwan') e
		WHERE cfg->'interfaces'->'wwan' IS NOT NULL AND (cfg->'interfaces'->'wwan')::text != 'null'
		  AND cfg->'overlay' IS NOT NULL AND (cfg->'overlay')::text != 'null'

		UNION ALL

		SELECT site_id, template_version_id,
			   cfg->'template'->>'name' AS template_name,
			   cfg->'version' AS template_version,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'name')::text) AS name,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'bonding'->'address')[0]::text) AS ip_address,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'bonding'->'bandwidth')[0]::text) AS bandwidth,
			   'bonding' AS type,
			   e->'bonding'->'islanif' AS islanif,
			   e->'ethernet'->'protect' AS protect
		FROM tv_json,
			 jsonb_array_elements(cfg->'interfaces'->'bonding') e
		WHERE cfg->'interfaces'->'bonding' IS NOT NULL AND (cfg->'interfaces'->'bonding')::text != 'null'
		  AND cfg->'overlay' IS NOT NULL AND (cfg->'overlay')::text != 'null'
	)
	SELECT
		s.id host,
		s.created_at,
		s.updated_at,
		'?' mac_addres,
		s.name site_name,
		stvs.type,
		split_part(coalesce(osr.interface_name, trim(both '""' from cast(stvs.name as text))), '.', 1) as iface_with_split,
		coalesce(osr.interface_name, trim(both '""' from cast(stvs.name as text))) as iface,
		osr.overlay_name as overlay_name,
		trim(both '""' from cast(stvs.name as text)) as overlay_iface_name,
		coalesce(osr.public_ip, stvs.ip_address) ip_address,
		coalesce(cast(stvs.bandwidth as integer), 10485760) bandwidth,
		cast(s.id as varchar) || '-' || trim(both '""' from cast(stvs.name as text)) as jn,
		coalesce(coalesce((s.location->>'latitude')::float, (parent_site.location->>'latitude')::float), 0) AS latitude,
		coalesce(coalesce((s.location->>'longitude')::float, (parent_site.location->>'longitude')::float), 0) AS longitude,
		s.operational_status,
		s.administrative_status,
		'?' as location_group,
		osr.carrier_type as carrier,
		case when osr.role = 'HUB' then 'true' else 'false' end ishub_value,
		stvs.islanif,
		stvs.protect as is_mng_iface,
		true is_configured,
		template_name,
		trim(both '""' from cast(stvs.template_version as text)) template_version,
		trim(both '""' from cast(s.device::jsonb->'id' as text)) device_id,
		trim(both '""' from cast(s.device::jsonb->'modelId' as text)) model_id
	FROM public.site s
	LEFT JOIN stvs_parsed stvs ON stvs.site_id = s.id
	LEFT JOIN public.overlay_site_relation osr ON osr.site_id = s.id AND osr.template_version_id = stvs.template_version_id
		 AND stvs.name = split_part(coalesce(osr.interface_name, trim(both '""' from cast(stvs.name as text))), '.', 1)
	LEFT JOIN public.site parent_site ON parent_site.id = s.parent_id
	WHERE s.device IS NOT NULL
	ORDER BY s.id
    " as i
	left join envanter.public.device device on i.device_id = cast(device.id as varchar)
